crossRefs.note: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Nazareth
people.line: The hometown of Jesus in Galilee

translations.web: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”
translations.bsb: So He asked them again, “Whom are you seeking?” “Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered.
translations.kjv: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
translations.asv: Again therefore he asked them, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
